observations.publisher: Reuters (reporting Russian transport ministry and Crimea governor)
observations.summary: Russian transport authorities reported a third attack on the Kerch Bridge this week and suspension of rail service while damage is assessed. Crimea's Russian-installed governor expected rail traffic to resume later Thursday. No independently verified additional structural damage or long-duration closure established. This is a new rail disruption within an ongoing strike campaign, not proof of a new interstate escalation phase.
observations.title: Third Kerch Bridge attack temporarily suspends rail traffic
